newsitem.title: USA: Jayhawk says may amend reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: Jayhawk says may amend reorganization plan.

text.p: Jayhawk Acceptance Corp said Monday collections from its automobile installment sale contracts, particularly in June, have been below the levels contemplated by its agreement with its primary secured lender.
The company said that unless actual collections exceed those currently projected, it will be required under this agreement to make prepayments to the lender.
The company said these prepayments would jeopardize its ability to make the other payments contemplated by its presently filed plan of reorganization within the time periods provided.
Consequently, the company said it plans to discuss with its secured lender and the unsecured creditors committee revisions in the timing of the payments.
Any revisions in the timing would require amendments to the plan of reorganization as presently filed.
The company said it expects an amended plan of reorganization would continue to provide for full payment of its indebtedness and contractual obligations.
